full_judgment:
ATM Afzal, J.: This appeal by the plaintiff following leave is from Judgment and Decree dated 16 February, 1984, passed by a Single Judge of the High Court Division (at Sylhet) in Second Appeal No. 554 of 1978 allowing the same. 

 4. The learned Assistant Judge, by judgment and decree dated 30.6.76, dismissed the suit but on appeal, the learned Subordinate Judge, Second Court, Sylhet, set aside the same and decreed the suit by his judgment and decree dated 29.12.77. Defendants 3-5 then filed the aforesaid Second Appeal in which the impugned judgment was passed.
